name: chrome-profile-links
title: Chrome Profile Links
description: Save links that open in a specific Google Chrome profile, or pick the profile every time you open them
author: h-tadashi

commands.name: search-profile-links
commands.title: Search Profile Links
commands.subtitle: Google Chrome
commands.description: Search saved links and Chrome bookmarks, and open them in their Google Chrome profile.

preferences.name: showBookmarks
preferences.title: Chrome Bookmarks
preferences.label: Show bookmarks from every profile
preferences.description: List the bookmarks of each Chrome profile next to your saved links. They open in the profile they belong to.

commands.name: create-profile-link
commands.title: Create Profile Link
commands.subtitle: Google Chrome
commands.description: Save a URL together with the Google Chrome profile it should open in.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
